overview: Incremental buildertools mapping for the pre-release JAR. Major themes: (1) brush parameter system overhaul — BrushData removed, brush parameters moved to tool args with builtin_ prefix; (2) revolve tool operation added; (3) scripted brush rotation operations added; (4) tint operation significantly enhanced with blend mode, color picking, and opacity; (5) prefab editor gains asset pack awareness and back navigation; (6) clipboard now carries entity data; (7) replace command refactored into subcommands; (8) undo grouping support added. Files read: 198 buildertools .java files in pre-release.

commands.name: PrefabEditBackCommand
commands.description: New command for navigating back from prefab edit session to the previous world. If player is in the edit world, teleports to the world they arrived from (using stored per-world last position). If player is outside the edit world, sends them to the edit world instead. Handles cases where the previous world no longer exists by falling back to default world spawn.

tool_operations.name: RevolveOperation
tool_operations.description: New revolve/radial copy tool operation. Copies a selection radially around a center point (player position or target block). Supports configurable copy count, distance override, entity copying, and three sampling modes.

tool_args.aSampling: Sampling mode: 'neighbor' (default, fills gaps using neighbor block matching), 'reverse' (uses BlockSelection.rotateArbitrary), 'none' (disabled)
tool_args.bCount: Number of copies around the circle (default 6)
tool_args.cFullRevolve: Boolean. When true, auto-calculates copy count from radius to achieve seamless coverage (10-2000 range, density=12 per radius unit), disables neighbor sampling
tool_args.dCenter: Center point: 'player' (player position) or 'target' (clicked block, default)
tool_args.eUseDistance: Boolean. When true, overrides radial distance from center
tool_args.eCopyEntities: Boolean. When true, copies entities within selection (max 1000 total)
tool_args.fDistance: Custom radial distance (default 20, only when eUseDistance=true)

features: Radial block rotation with snapped 90-degree yaw increments
Neighbor sampling: fills gaps by checking 8 XZ neighbor offsets and placing fractional-offset copies
Reverse sampling: uses BlockSelection.rotateArbitrary for continuous rotation
Entity rotation: clones entities with rotated position and orientation, assigns new UUIDs
Block rotation preservation via RotationTuple yaw composition

scripted_brush_operations.name: ClearRotationOperation
scripted_brush_operations.description: New scripted brush operation that resets brush rotation transform to identity. Calls brushConfig.resetTransform() and resets transform origin to current offset origin. Registered as 'clearrotation' in BrushOperation.OPERATION_CODEC.

scripted_brush_operations.name: RotateOperation
scripted_brush_operations.description: New scripted brush operation that applies rotation to the brush shape. Configurable via CODEC with RotationAxis (BrushAxis enum), RotationAngle (protocol Rotation enum: None/90/180/270), and RotationOrigin. Registered as 'rotation' in BrushOperation.OPERATION_CODEC.

ui.name: PrefabEditorLoadOptionsPage
ui.description: New UI page shown when a player has an existing prefab edit session and tries to load. Offers three options: LoadExisting (rejoin existing session), CreateNew (exit current session and open load settings), or Cancel. Uses Pages/PrefabEditorLoadOptions.ui template.

inner_types.PageData: CODEC-based data class with action field

removed_types.name: PrefabSetAnchorInteraction
removed_types.reason: Interaction replaced by dedicated PrefabSetAnchor packet (id=426, ToServer). The CODEC registration for 'PrefabSetAnchorInteraction' is removed from BuilderToolsPlugin.setup().

changes.description: Brush parameters (width, height, thickness, shape, density, spacing, capped, material) previously read from BrushData are now read from tool args with 'builtin_' prefix (e.g., 'builtin_Width', 'builtin_Height'). BrushData class removed entirely.

New static method resolveTargetPack(explicitPackName, prefabPath, playerComponent, context) for resolving which AssetPack to save prefabs to. Checks explicit name first, then source pack of prefab path, then user's lastSavePack preference, then base asset pack. Returns null with error message if all options fail or are immutable.

Added PlayerReadyEvent handler that re-sends selection to client when a player reconnects with existing state. Added LoadedAssetsEvent and RemovedAssetsEvent handlers for Item class that invalidate ScriptedBrushAsset brush-to-item cache.
PrefabSetAnchorInteraction CODEC registration removed. PrefabSpawnerState page registration changed to PrefabSpawnerBlock with registerBlockEntityCustomPage (was registerBlockCustomPage).
Two new scripted brush operations registered: 'rotation' (RotateOperation) and 'clearrotation' (ClearRotationOperation).

BuilderToolData replaced by BuilderTool. Tool arg update now calls builderToolData.updateArgMetadata(itemStack, id, value) instead of tool.updateArgMetadata(itemStack, group, id, value) — group parameter removed.
New constants: MAX_CLIPBOARD_BLOCK_COUNT = 4000000, CLIPBOARD_PRE_LIMIT_FACTOR = 1.65. Clipboard operations now enforce block count limits.
Block entity creation for block changes simplified. BlockState/BlockStateModule logic removed; only blockEntity clone path retained.
ActionType enum modified (visible in diff but truncated). Some action types likely added or restructured.

brush_parameter_system.description: Complete overhaul of how brush parameters are communicated between client and server. The dedicated BrushData struct and BuilderToolBrushData packet type are removed. Instead, brush parameters are encoded as standard tool args with 'builtin_' prefix in the tool arg map.
brush_parameter_system.old_approach: BrushData.Values read from BuilderToolBrushData packet field on BuilderToolState
brush_parameter_system.new_approach: Individual tool args: builtin_Width, builtin_Height, builtin_Thickness, builtin_Capped, builtin_Shape, builtin_Density, builtin_Spacing, builtin_Material read from args.tool() map

undo_grouping.description: New ability to group multiple brush operations into a single undo step via BuilderToolOnUseInteraction.undoGroupSize field.

clipboard_entity_support.description: Clipboard operations (selection transform reply) now include entity data via ClipboardEntityChange array. This enables entity previews during transform operations.

prefab_asset_pack_awareness.description: Prefab editor system now tracks and resolves asset packs for save/load operations. Users get a 'lastSavePack' preference persisted in BuilderToolsUserData. Save commands check pack immutability. New PrefabEditorLoadOptionsPage handles session conflicts.

tint_operation_enhancement.description: TintOperation gained blend mode (primary click blends tint with opacity), alt-click color picking (samples existing tint and updates tool arg), and spatial tracking via color buffer.

replace_command_refactor.description: ReplaceCommand refactored from flag-based (--substringSwap, --regex) to subcommand-based architecture. Main command does simple block replace; ReplaceSwapCommand handles substring swap; ReplaceRegexCommand handles regex. From-value now uses BlockMask for type-safe matching.

scripted_brush_rotation.description: Two new scripted brush operations enable rotation control within brush scripts: 'rotation' (apply axis/angle rotation to brush shape) and 'clearrotation' (reset rotation to identity). BrushConfig gains resetTransform() and setTransformOrigin() methods.
